# Leonardo Cofone

> Leonardo Cofone is a 17-year-old AI Researcher & Engineer from Italy, focused on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs). He builds and researches intelligent systems and real-world AI applications, working with both pre-trained and custom models, and developing AI agents capable of learning, reasoning and solving real-world tasks.

Official website: https://leonardocofone.github.io/Leonardo_Cofone/

## Profile

- **Name:** Leonardo Cofone
- **Role:** AI Researcher & Engineer
- **Age:** 17
- **Location:** Trento, Italy
- **Education:** Galileo Galilei Scientific High School, Trento (expected graduation: June 2028)
- **Core skills:** Python (advanced), C++ (basic), HTML, CSS, JavaScript (basic), Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, neural networks, predictive modeling.

## Experience

- **Mentee** – Lead The Future Mentorship, Milan, Italy (September 2026 – Present, remote): Among the few Italian students selected as mentees for LeadTheFuture, a leading non-profit mentorship organization for STEM students (acceptance rate below 20%), receiving one-on-one guidance from high-impact mentors from hubs such as Silicon Valley and CERN.
- **Guest Researcher** – Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems (MPI-IS), Tübingen, Germany (July 2026 – Present, hybrid): Research collaboration in the Deep Models and Optimization group, working on looped models and the efficiency of deep architectures. Worked through recent literature on efficient deep architectures and presented his own paper and independent work to the group.
- **Python Developer** – Airpim Srl, Rovereto, Italy (June 2026, 1 month, on-site): Designed and built a zero-dependency Python tool for automatic memory leak diagnostics, with adaptive statistics that tell real leaks apart from normal allocation noise and root-cause localization on the object graph. Validated in production.
- **AI Developer** – EgoLog Srl, Milan, Italy (August 2025 – February 2026, 7 months, remote): Built and deployed AI agent systems in n8n for social media management, data enrichment and lead generation, end to end: requirements, workflow design, integration with existing systems and maintenance in production.
- **AI Developer** – Top Evolutions Srl, Trento, Italy (June 2025 – August 2025, 3 months, hybrid): AI automation for businesses in the payments space, building prompt-driven systems that matched merchants with the most suitable payment provider, plus lead generation automation. Early on also trained models on the client's data.

## Research & Projects

- **DSALT (Dynamic Sparse Attention with Landmark Tokens)**: Research on Transformer attention mechanisms. Introduces a dynamic sparse attention mechanism combining local windowed attention with globally selected landmark tokens (hybrid energy-based scoring) to improve long-context efficiency and representation quality.
  - Paper (Zenodo): https://zenodo.org/records/19312826
  - Official Python library: https://github.com/LeonardoCofone/dsalt-library
- **LerriAI**: A personal AI assistant built as a system of intelligent agents that plan, remind, summarize and track progress to help users organize their lives. (Currently offline)
  - Live demo: https://leonardocofone.github.io/LerriAI/
  - Frontend repo: https://github.com/LeonardoCofone/LerriAI
  - Full code repo: https://github.com/LeonardoCofone/LerriAI_PUBLIC
